scene: In a quiet dressing corner, Dad kneels screen-left and Child stands screen-right beside a low bench. Exactly two choice shirts lie on the bench: one red shirt with white stripes at bench-left and one red shirt with a single dinosaur graphic at bench-right. Both patterns are visible from the first frame and stay on their original red shirts; never add a third choice shirt. Child is the four-year-old tiger boy. His yellow T-shirt stays on throughout; he receives the dinosaur shirt and prepares to get dressed after the clip, with no wardrobe jump. The locked 16:9 medium two-shot includes both faces, hands and both choice shirts.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Dad and Child are attentive and relaxed, with normal family conversation volume and restrained faces and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child briefly considers the visible patterns, then shows mild pleasure with a small smile and nod. Dad's clarification stays patient and matter-of-fact.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, bouncing, cheering, forceful pointing or raised voices. Do not stretch faces or bodies or turn Child's confirmation into a shout.

A.start: Dad kneels screen-left with empty hands; Child stands screen-right wearing his yellow T-shirt; the red striped shirt lies at bench-left and the red dinosaur shirt at bench-right.
A.action: Dad invites a choice with a small open-hand gesture over both red shirts. Child looks at the pair while making his color-only choice; he does not point out the dinosaur yet. Dad notes the shared color while indicating both shirts together. Keep the patterns clearly visible and do not rearrange the clothes.
A.end: Dad and Child remain beside the bench with empty hands; the red striped shirt stays at bench-left and the red dinosaur shirt at bench-right; Child still wears his yellow T-shirt.

B.start: Dad and Child remain beside the bench with empty hands; the red striped shirt stays at bench-left and the red dinosaur shirt at bench-right; Child still wears his yellow T-shirt.
B.action: Dad briefly indicates the two patterns during his question. Child identifies the dinosaur with his words and a small pointing gesture. Dad lifts the red dinosaur shirt from bench-right with both hands, keeping its graphic visible, and checks the choice. Child confirms with a small nod at normal volume and lowers his hand. The striped shirt never moves.
B.end: Dad holds the red dinosaur shirt with both hands just above bench-right, graphic facing Child; the red striped shirt rests at bench-left; Child has empty hands and still wears his yellow T-shirt.

C.start: Dad holds the red dinosaur shirt with both hands just above bench-right, graphic facing Child; the red striped shirt rests at bench-left; Child has empty hands and still wears his yellow T-shirt.
C.action: Dad offers the dinosaur shirt during his opening turn. Child takes it with both hands below his face and thanks Dad. Dad asks about the next dressing step; Child agrees with a small nod while holding the shirt ready. Keep his yellow T-shirt on and the chosen shirt in his hands; changing clothes happens after this clip.
C.end: Child holds the red dinosaur shirt with both hands below his face, in front of his unchanged yellow T-shirt; the red striped shirt rests at bench-left; Dad has empty hands and both remain beside the bench.
